dogecoin.text:
How to short dogecoin?

Asking for a friend...
Dogecoin down -18% in the two days since this tweet. Nobody answered 😔

Bitcoin -13.5%

If this happened to my stocks, I know I’d buy more. Because fundamentals, you know.

When no more people join the Ponzi scheme and people in the scheme start to leave it...

@MarceloPLima I know we are sound people, but sometimes I wonder if it’s not our obligations to scream into their faces that Dogecoin is the last dustbin they should throw their hard earned savings in.

Doesn’t help much if otherwise inspiring people like Elon Musk popularize it.
